text: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee states rate cuts are not appropriate while core PCE inflation runs at 3%, above the 2% target. Futures markets price delayed easing probabilities into midyear. Policy stance remains unchanged following prior quarter-point reductions in 2025.

meta.note: Statement reflects individual policymaker; FOMC decision unchanged at time of remarks.

text: Savannah Guthrie publicly offers up to $1 million for information leading to recovery of Nancy Guthrie, missing since Jan. 31 in Arizona. Pima County Sheriff's Office classifies case as possible abduction. FBI maintains separate $100,000 reward. Investigation remains active with no confirmed recovery.

meta.note: Private reward intersects with public law enforcement; classification relies on reported sheriff statement.

text: Spirit Airlines outlines plan in U.S. Bankruptcy Court to reduce Airbus fleet, cut debt and lease obligations from $7.4B to $2.1B, and shrink network to high-demand routes. Fleet mix shifts toward older aircraft with potential rejection of higher-cost models. Cost reductions and creditor agreements disclosed.

meta.note: Second bankruptcy within year; fleet size contingent on ongoing lessor negotiations.

text: Warner Bros. Discovery rerceives revised $31 per share all-cash proposal from Paramount Skydance while existing Netflix merger agreement remains in force at $27.75 per share for studio and streaming assets. Break-up fees and ticking provisions disclosed. Board states no determination on superiority of revised offer.

meta.note: Competing bids coexist under contractual constraints; superiority standard defined by prior agreement.
